content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched the all-new Valet accessory, which they describe as a "wireless charging stand and catchall for personal items."

Now, Twelve South is expanding the Valet line with a new, more compact model featuring MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at speeds up to 25W.

The first-generation Valet, announced earlier this year, measures 7.5 inches and can hold items such as phones, keys, wallets, and glasses. However, the new Valet has been significantly reduced in size to 4.25 inches.

Here is Twelve South's description of the premium Valet design:

The design philosophy behind Valet is to first create a beautiful home accessory, then a precision wireless charger. It blends warm materials with modern precision craftsmanship to create a calmer, more thoughtful form that fits anywhere in the home—from the entryway console, kitchen, to bedside table. The soft square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray. Meanwhile, the weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything stable and orderly.

In terms of features, the smaller Valet is more than capable of charging your iPhone. It also includes an additional USB-C port for charging other accessories:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather tray
  • Four configurable placement orientations
  • Interchangeable, removable leather bumper
  • Weighted zinc alloy base with hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port providing up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes 45W power adapter and 1.5m USB-C cable

The Twelve South 4.25-inch Valet is now available for pre-order at $129.99, in three colour combinations. Although not cheap, it is an attractive charging dock that not only charges your phone but also holds glasses, a wallet, or keys.
